purpose: Prevent avoidable open ends. Every unresolved item must receive one final targeted official-source sweep before it may remain in the backlog.

mandatoryFinalSweep.appliesTo: all researched municipalities, retroactively and prospectively
mandatoryFinalSweep.trigger: any item still open after initial research, deepening, retest and closure search
requiredSearchLayers: official municipal council/college decisions and attachments
official executing agency/omgevingsdienst pages where municipality delegates the route
allowedFinalOpenClasses: address/location/geometry dependent and impossible to determine without a concrete address
dynamic Omgevingsloket or live-form output that cannot be determined generically
case/exception-specific evidence that only appears after applicant choices
not further determinable after documented repeated official-source searches
mandatoryFinalSweep.prohibitedShortcut: Do not leave an item open merely because the first closure search did not find it.

batchGate: No municipality or batch is marked research-complete until every residual has either been closed by the final sweep or assigned one of the allowed final-open classes with a reason.
excelAndBacklogRule: Backlog and Excel synchronization occurs only after the final sweep for the municipalities concerned.
